races.title: British Stallion Studs EBF 'National Hunt' Novices' Hurdle (GBB Race)
races.verdict: LORD DU GOUET continued his promising start to his career switched to hurdling when second at Fontwell 4 weeks ago and this looks an excellent opportunity for him to go one better. Eagle Warrior is considered the main threat following a perfectly encouraging first effort over hurdles in a strongly-run contest at Carlisle. Loopy Mag and Order Driven can battle it out for third spot. LORD DU GOUET (FR) EAGLE WARRIOR (IRE) LOOPY MAG (FR)

races.title: Weatherbys And Birdie Calendars 'Chasing Excellence' Beginners' Chase (GBB Race)
races.verdict: It looks significant that JULIUS DES PICTONS goes chasing already after his win in a Grade 1 at Aintree on his first attempt at this trip, so is preferred to Derryhassen Paddy and Fishery Lane in what is a strong event of its type. JULIUS DES PICTONS (FR) DERRYHASSEN PADDY (IRE) FISHERY LANE (FR)
races.bettingForecast: Derryhassen Paddy (1/1), Julius Des Pictons (9/4), Fishery Lane (3/1), Pinot Rouge (33/1)

races.title: Paul Ferguson's Jumpers To Follow Handicap Hurdle (Div 1)
races.verdict: Unlike most of these, TAKEYOUTOTHEISLAND brings an unexposed profile to the table so he's selected to make a successful reappearance. De Deli Counter is fit and in form so will doubtless be popular, with Wind Your Neck In also of some interest with a reappearance under his belt. TAKEYOUTOTHEISLAND (IRE) DE DELI COUNTER WIND YOUR NECK IN (IRE)

races.title: Paul Ferguson's Jumpers To Follow Handicap Hurdle (Div 2)
races.verdict: RATEMENOW picked up where he left off in the spring when finding only a handicap debutant too good at Market Rasen on his reappearance and is the percentage call to go one better on the back of a breathing operation. Fourofakind showed more promise than the bare result suggests back from another break at Carlisle on his most recent outing and needs a close look having fallen a long way in the weights, with stable-switcher Je Mr Dawson also of interest. RATEMENOW (IRE) FOUROFAKIND (IRE) JE MR DAWSON (FR)

races.title: QuinnBet Handicap Chase
races.verdict: SCAIRP DUBH had excuses here last time so is well worth another chance to confirm the promise of his chase debut win over C&D in May. Drop Kick built up a solid record over hurdles and he's likely to make a chaser, so is feared most ahead of Kinbara Firstdraft and Halpha Soleil . SCAIRP DUBH DROP KICK (IRE) KINBARA FIRSTDRAFT (IRE)

races.title: QuinnBet Open NH Flat Race (GBB Race)
races.verdict: MAX POTENTIAL held every chance when falling at the last on his outing in Irish points in March and, having subsequently been purchased for a whopping £280,000, he makes obvious appeal on his Rules debut, especially with good-value claimer Rian Corcoran in the saddle. Rio Blue is in top hands and also ticks plenty of boxes on paper, so warrants respect, while Yorgunnarock has achieved the most of those with Rules experience as things stand. MAX POTENTIAL RIO BLUE (IRE) YORGUNNAROCK
